sentences.text: By means of this application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C., applicant Vikas, who is involved in Case Crime No. 30 of 2022, under Sections 376, 506 IPC, Sections 3/4 and 16/17 POCSO Act, police station Sachendi, district Kanpur Nagar, seeks enlargement on bail during the pendency of trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Vikas vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023.json

sentences.text: As per prosecution case, in brief, informant, who is father of the victim, lodged the first information report of this case on 24.01.2022 against the present applicant Vikas and co-accused Mithun with the allegation inter alia that on 23.01.2022 at 04:30 P.M., his minor daughter aged about 14 years had gone to the field where the applicant and co-accused Mithun reached and started teasing her.
sentences._hearing_file: Vikas vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023.json

The accused persons also threatened her that in case she tells anything about the incident, she will Vikas vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64653711/
1 face consequences.
Main substratum of argument of learned counsel for the applicant is that the F.I.R. has been lodged by father of the victim on the narration of the incident by the victim but there is no allegation of rape against the applicant.

sentences.text: He further pointed out that even when statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. of the victim was recorded, she did not make allegation of rape against the applicant but later on, when her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. was recorded on 31.01.2022 after six days of lodging the F.I.R., she has improved her case making allegation inter alia that the applicant disrobing her committed misdeed with her.

sentences.text: Referring to the medical examination report of the victim, it is pointed out that no internal or external injury has been found on the body of the victim, which also falsify the prosecution case.

sentences.text: The applicant does not have any criminal history to his credit.
sentences._hearing_file: Vikas vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023.json

sentences.text: Lastly, it is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that there is no chance of the applicant fleeing away from the judicial process or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
sentences._hearing_file: Vikas vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023.json

sentences.text: The applicant is languishing in jail since 28.04.2022 and in case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and cooperate with the trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Vikas vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023.json

sentences.text: Per contra, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel for the opposite parties opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant but do not dispute the above factual aspect of the matter as argued on behalf of the applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Vikas vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023.json

sentences.text: Having heard learned counsel for the parties and examined the matter in its entirety, I find that in the F.I.R. as well as in the statement of the victim under Section 161 Cr.P.C., there is no allegation of rape against the applicant but the same was improved by the victim in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. in order to increase the gravity of the offence, therefore, possibility of false implication of the applicant cannot be ruled out.
sentences._hearing_file: Vikas vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case as well as keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused and submissions of the learned counsel for the parties,
this Court is of the opinion that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Vikas vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023.json

sentences.text: Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.
sentences._hearing_file: Vikas vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Let the applicant Vikas, be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions, which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) That the applicant shall cooperate in the expeditious disposal of the trial and shall regularly attend the court unless inevitable.
(ii) That the applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) That after his release, the applicant shall not involve in any criminal activity.

Vikas vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 22 March, 2023
Author: Sanjay Kumar Singh
Bench: Sanjay Kumar Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 75
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 52211 of 2022
Applicant :- Vikas
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Ramesh Singh,Achint Ranjan Singh
opennyai_summary.22_March_2023__facts:
By means of this application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C., applicant Vikas, who is involved in Case Crime No. 30 of 2022, under Sections 376, 506 IPC, Sections 3/4 and 16/17 POCSO Act, police station Sachendi, district Kanpur Nagar, seeks enlargement on bail during the pendency of trial.
As per prosecution case, in brief, informant, who is father of the victim, lodged the first information report of this case on 24.01.2022 against the present applicant Vikas and co-accused Mithun with the allegation inter alia that on 23.01.2022 at 04:30 P.M., his minor daughter aged about 14 years had gone to the field where the applicant and co-accused Mithun reached and started teasing her.
opennyai_summary.22_March_2023__arguments:
He further pointed out that even when statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C. of the victim was recorded, she did not make allegation of rape against the applicant but later on, when her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. was recorded on 31.01.2022 after six days of lodging the F.I.R., she has improved her case making allegation inter alia that the applicant disrobing her committed misdeed with her.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 28.04.2022 and in case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and cooperate with the trial.
opennyai_summary.22_March_2023__ANALYSIS:
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and examined the matter in its entirety, I find that in the F.I.R. as well as in the statement of the victim under Section 161 Cr.P.C., there is no allegation of rape against the applicant but the same was improved by the victim in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. in order to increase the gravity of the offence, therefore, possibility of false implication of the applicant cannot be ruled out.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case as well as keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused and submissions of the learned counsel for the parties,
this Court is of the opinion that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
opennyai_summary.22_March_2023__decision:
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.
Let the applicant Vikas, be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions, which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) That the applicant shall cooperate in the expeditious disposal of the trial and shall regularly attend the court unless inevitable.
(ii) That the applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) That after his release, the applicant shall not involve in any criminal activity.
(iv) The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by court concerned.
In case of breach of any of the conditions mentioned above, court concerned will be at liberty to cancel the bail.

The applicant on false promise to marry, established physical relationship with her due to which she became pregnant.
When she told him to marry her,
he refused.
His parents also refused for marriage.
His daughter is having pregnancy of about three months.
opennyai_summary.18_September_2023__arguments:
It is argued that charge sheet in the matter has been submitted against the applicant.
It is argued that bail application of the applicant be rejected.
opennyai_summary.18_September_2023__ANALYSIS:
7. After having heard learned counsels for the parties and perusing the records, it is evident that as of now only document with regards to age of the victim is School Leaving Certificate of Class-8th.
Perusal of the same would go to show that the victim was aged about 14 years at the time of incident and as such she was a minor and consent of a minor is of no worth.
opennyai_summary.18_September_2023__decision:
8. Looking into the facts and circumstances of the case as well as nature and gravity of the offence, I am not inclined to release the applicant on bail.
9. The bail application is, accordingly, rejected.

He submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 5.4.2024 having no previous criminal history.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A have vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of bail but could not dispute the above contention made by the learned counsel for the applicant.

7. Let the applicant- Vikas, who is involved in aforementioned case crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
(i) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the date fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in Court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the Trial Court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(ii) The applicant shall remain present before the Trial Court on each date fixed,
either personally or through his counsel.
